description: Sums the Defense (per defense damage type), Evasion, FP and Stamina item properties of worn gear; every other property, and Defense of a damage type that has no Defense rating, is ignored.
inputs: Item property lists applied in order to a new EquipmentStatTotals. Defense subtypes are CombatDamageType ids (1 Physical, 2 Force, 3 Fire, 99 undefined, which is refused with an exception).
rows: HP bonus 10 (not an equipment record stat)
